title: Turing machine for a labelled program
statement: Let $A$ assign an instruction to each label in $\Lambda$, and choose an initial label. Define a machine with $m$ work tapes and states consisting of a label paired with a phase. Its initial state is the chosen label paired with the start phase; its transition function is the labelled instruction transition action, and its call function is the labelled call specification.
hypotheses_covered: Natural numbers of registers $m$ and deciders $d$
